name: Niko
source:
A shikigami and a faithful servant of [url=https://vndb.org/c34800]Madara Yakou[/url]. She is not the only one of his shikigami; the other one is [url=https://vndb.org/c34805]Teirei[/url].

Niko has a cheerful personality and deems herself a maiden. She expresses her feelings openly. Like, then others praise her, and sometimes even ask for praise. It is harder to deal with her than with [url=https://vndb.org/c34805]Teirei[/url].

For some reason, she does not like [url=https://vndb.org/c34802]Kyougetsu Keishirou[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c34803]Sakuya[/url].
